comparison.objective: Play a two-hand keyboard passage with simultaneous timing and force-dependent dynamics; candidate performs bearing service transfer.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests rapid bimanual key sequencing, velocity control, note release, and rhythm. Candidate tests slow geometric alignment, contact regulation, and mechanical containment.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires the specified note order, beat, bass duration, velocity contrast, no extra notes, and all keys/hands released. Candidate requires complete damage-free transfer with all balls retained.
comparison.reason: Only generic bimanual coordination is shared; the tested abilities and outcomes are unrelated.
